mentions.name: AI research firehose digest tool
mentions.description: This tool eases the burden of keeping up with the flood of AI news and research, processing hundreds of daily research papers to surface the valuable insight scattered across them that would otherwise require superhuman reading ability to find.
mentions.problem: Hundreds of new AI research papers are published every day, and a large amount of valuable insight is distributed across them, requiring a superhuman ability to read, comprehend, and test all of it.
mentions.source_excerpt: working on a way to ease the burden of the firehose of information that is current AI news and research. there are hunderds of new research papers everyday, and yeah, skimming is a thing, but i feel like there is a ton of alpha distributed thorugh all of them that would just require a superhuman ability to read, comprehend and test all of it
